description: Three independent sample and hold sections sharing one twelve-note quantizer

params.text: Lit, the voltage sampled by that section is snapped to a note of the scale at 1V per octave
Chooses how a sample becomes a note: Prop spreads the active notes evenly across each volt, Nearest takes the closest active note, Clamp takes one only within half a semitone and else holds
Adds that note to the scale used by all three sections, or takes it out; the last remaining note cannot be switched off

inputs.text: A rising edge samples the voltage at the IN jack of that section; with nothing patched here that section never samples
The voltage that section samples when its HOLD input receives a rising edge; with nothing patched a fresh random voltage between 0V and 1V is sampled instead

outputs.text: The voltage that section has held since its last sample, limited to -5V to 5V
Rests at 10V and drops to 0V for 1ms whenever a sample changes the held voltage, staying at 10V when the new sample repeats the old one

notes: A section samples only while a cable is in its HOLD input; with that jack empty its output holds whatever it last had and never changes
